gaps: provider-computed/apply-time values, remote state contents and actual remote resource identities remain terminal runtime ceilings

a declaration is identified by its last label alone: omega-hcl publishes the block type and the resource type label as attributes, and the overlay renders canonical keys from fields only, so aws_vpc.main and aws_subnet.main share one key

data-source references are not stated: a traversal data.aws_ami.web names the type in its first segment, and the Pack states only the first segment, so the reference cannot be addressed to the data source's own key

attribute values are not stated: omega-hcl carries a scalar value as an attribute, so module source, provider alias, backend settings and count/for_each expressions are materialized as declarations without their values
dynamic block expansion cardinality and count/for_each instance keys are not evaluated; authored meta/dynamic syntax is materialized
conditional/template effective value normalization requires HCL evaluation and is outside the source-only Framework contract
